title: Parallel Runs, Test Data, CI Integration

scenes.line1: How do you scale test automation?
scenes.say: Want your UI tests to run faster and give quick feedback? Let’s break down parallel runs, test data, and CI integration.

scenes.label: Speed
scenes.sub: Playwright and Cypress run tests in parallel easily. Selenium needs extra setup.
scenes.say: Playwright and Cypress make parallel test runs simple. Selenium takes more work to set up.
Managing test data is key. Isolate tests, make them repeatable, and clean up after each run.

scenes.title: Automate Test Runs
scenes.say: CI tools like GitHub Actions or Jenkins run your tests automatically when code changes. Set up parallel runs for fast feedback.

scenes.question: Does Selenium run tests in parallel natively?
scenes.right: No, Selenium needs extra setup for parallel execution.
scenes.say: Interviewers might ask if Selenium runs tests in parallel by default. It doesn’t—extra setup is needed.
